source.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_batch_remediation.py tests/test_correction_frontier.py tests/test_review.py tests/test_github_issue_remediation_intent.py tests/test_correction_dispatch.py

claims.claim: The versioned batch contract binds 2–32 explicit distinct CODE_FIX findings to one exact source REVIEW, TASK revision and candidate, preserving legacy single-finding decoding.
Authoring authenticates immutable source subjects, combined scope, constraints and verification, with deterministic replay and freshness and overlap guards.
Human intent, carrier, approval, dispatch and preflight preserve the bound batch selection and execution profile. Carrier isolation assertions now include the existing ingress provenance gates.
Batch execution preserves immutable source identities in one cumulative RUN and Executor invocation, with competing-continuation, consumed-authority and execution-base checks.
Batch package validation requires a nonempty scoped committed delta and exact successful per-command evidence bound to its RUN and result candidate.
Versioned multi-finding DELTA reviews require independent outcomes for every selected finding and support partial resolution and new defects while retaining legacy review contracts.

Frontier reduction closes only explicit Reviewer-PASS findings and retains unresolved, blocked, foreign and new findings. Direct blob reads restore authenticated batch observation under deep Windows temporary paths.
Publisher authenticates the reviewed candidate and requires an empty complete correction frontier before publication.
Batch-aware review material, returns and correction transports use explicit versioned identities and reject legacy single-finding reinterpretation.

Synthetic coverage includes batch success, partial retention, invalid selectors, forged evidence, conflicts, publication blocking and legacy flow; the repair adds authenticated deep-observer coverage. Ten selected local tests passed assertions, but pytest exited 1 for an observer profile/toolchain mismatch. Canonical verification remains Runtime-owned.
Versioned documentation describes explicit selection, one-Executor workflow, per-finding review, partial recovery, publication gating and unknown real-world savings.
The repair changes only three authorized paths and introduces no authority or verification-policy change. Final HEAD is a clean committed descendant of the exact failed candidate.
